verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say that once you set a goal or task, it keeps working on a schedule and in response to relevant events after you close the app. It monitors, follows up and notifies you, and the Goals tab is where you track and manage these ongoing tasks. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how schedules and event triggers are configured, clarity on how much runs unattended given approvals are required before actions like emails and purchases, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable background execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Once you've set a goal or a task, Muse continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up
Muse keeps things moving after you close the app. It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention
The Goals tab is where Muse keeps track of all this for you, and you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.
